I see discrepancies between comment count/score on the front page vs. subs/posts all the time; it's due to the way Voat handles caching. The front page is not generated from database content every time you load it; that would nuke the database server. So a static version is cached and re-generated every so often. This can also be exacerbated by Cloudflare doing it's own caching, especially during high loads/DDOS attacks etc.

Usually the effect is not this pronounced, but my guess is the site came back online with a very old copy of the front page in the cache, and it stuck around until the next cache refresh was triggered.
